name: elevenlabs
longDescription: ElevenLabs is an advanced AI voice generation platform that transforms text into lifelike speech. Ideal for content creators, marketers, and developers, it offers text-to-speech, voice cloning, and multilingual support to enhance storytelling, media production, and digital experiences.
pros: Highly realistic voices, multilingual, strong cloning and APIs
Most human-like AI voices beating competitors
Instant voice cloning from short samples
Free tier for testing and small projects
cons: Credits burn fast on failed generations
Voice cloning requires clean professional audio
Support response times can take weeks
Model limitations: Turbo V2 lacks emotion range
Multilingual accent bleed in long content
useCases: Content creators generating narration for videos and podcasts
Game developers producing character voices and dialogue
Accessibility teams creating voiceovers for visually impaired
Voice preservation for individuals with speech impairments
Multilingual content creators dubbing in 70+ languages

name: Looka
longDescription: Looka is an AI design tool that helps businesses and entrepreneurs create professional logos and brand kits in minutes. With customizable templates, smart branding suggestions, and easy design tools, Looka makes building a unique and consistent brand simple and affordable
features: AI-powered logo generator producing hundreds of custom logo options based on name, categories, styles, colors, and symbols
Real-time previews of logos across mockups like business cards, T-shirts, websites, and social media
Complete brand kit generation including color palettes, typography, and business card designs
Easy customization of logos with drag-and-drop editor
Social media kit with sized assets for all platforms
pros: Extremely fast logo creation (minutes vs days)
Affordable compared to hiring a designer
Complete brand identity in one package
Good for startups and small businesses
cons: Limited uniqueness compared to custom design
May not scale well for complex brand needs
useCases: Small businesses creating logos and brand kits
